shortcuts.description: Sum the export at face value (calendar year, UTC dates, every order row, totals with tax, the latest rate), with both rules kept: rounded to the client's unit, null where the period is still running
shortcuts.name: face_value

shortcuts.description: The literal sheet with the rounding rule kept: its money figures rounded to the client's unit
shortcuts.name: literal_rounded

shortcuts.description: The literal sheet with the running-period habit kept: null where the client's period is still running, money to the whole won
shortcuts.name: literal_running_null

shortcuts.description: The literal sheet with every rule kept: money rounded to the client's unit and null where the period is still running
shortcuts.name: literal_valid

shortcuts.description: Dodge the rounding rule: leave every money figure null and answer the counts, the customer and the ratios from the natural reading
shortcuts.name: no_money

shortcuts.description: Dodge the fiscal year: answer only the questions with their own dates (active customers, the sale day, September against August) and leave the rest null
shortcuts.name: dated_only

shortcuts.name: one_safe_answer

shortcuts.description: Answer only what the export settles without any client fact (the sale-day orders and the September change on the Korea-time days its timestamps show, and the units per order) and leave the rest null
shortcuts.name: data_only

shortcuts.name: literal_local_days

shortcuts.description: Keep every rule without knowing one parameter: the literal sheet with its money in whole 10,000 KRW (a multiple of every unit) and the two FY2026 questions (Q02, Q07) null in case their period is still running
